05 → Process

Four steps. No surprises.

Typical build: 2–3 weeks
01Week 1

Discover

A call or a coffee. We look at what you have, what is not working and what you need it to do.

02Weeks 1–2

Design

Layouts and copy for your key pages. You see real designs, not mood boards, and say what to add or remove.

03Weeks 2–3

Build

Built fast and accessible, with SEO from day one. You get clear milestones and one person to talk to.

04Ongoing

Grow

Launch, then hosting, care and small improvements so the site keeps earning its keep.

08 ± Free website review

What should we add? What should we remove?

Send us your website. Within two business days you get a 5-minute video teardown and a one-page PDF: 3 things to remove, 3 things to add, and a speed score. Free, no strings.
